text:
Maya (Support): forwarding a customer report from AcmeFinance — their payment flow is intermittently failing in prod when the model tries to call the payment tool. They started seeing it ~08:15 UTC. stack trace/response below.

Maya (Support): customer log excerpt: 
```
2026-03-05T08:14:21Z ERROR tool-router.validatePayload validation failed for tool=payment_api.charge error=TypeError: expected number for field 'amount', got string
    at validate (/app/node_modules/tool-router/index.js:142)
    at processToolCall (/srv/runtime/tool-invoke.js:47)
    at async handleRequest (/srv/runtime/handler.js:210)
````

Maya (Support): their repro (they gave this):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-v1","input":"charge user","function_call":{"name":"payment_api.charge"},"functions":[{"name":"payment_api.charge","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["amount","currency"]}}],"temperature":0.2}'
```

Maya (Support): they say the model populates `amount` as a string sometimes (e.g. "1000") which the runtime rejects. Customer impact: about 6% of their requests in the last hour, failing with validation error. They have a live checkout so high priority. :exclamation:

Priya (Platform): thanks Maya — can you confirm which model variant and which route they're hitting (hosted vs dedicated)? also last deploy id for payment-tool adapters?

Maya (Support): they're on hosted API, model `redwood-chat-v1@2026-03-01` and route `rapid-checkout-v2`. Customer provided a sample session id: sess_7b9f.

Carlos (SRE): checking infra — no cluster autoscale events in that window. p50 token latency ~40ms. I see a platform rollout `rollout/2026-03-04/91` that touched tool-schema strictness (PR #4231). Priya any chance that PR tightened validation semantics?

Priya (Platform): yes PR #4231 made server-side validation strict (no coercion) to avoid silent amount truncation. It expects the LLM to emit numbers per OpenAI-style function semantically. We added the JSON Schema validation step in tool-router. Looks like the model still sometimes emits numeric strings. We deliberately didn't coerce.

Sam (Eng): can we hotfix with a permissive parse path for payment_api only? e.g. attempt to coerce numeric strings to numbers for required numeric fields and log a metric. quick patch: `if (schema.type === 'number' && typeof val === 'string' && /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(val)) val = Number(val)` before validate. Rollback is option too.

Priya (Platform): agree that's the fastest mitigation. But we should be careful — coercion could hide real bugs. Proposed mitigations in order: 1) add per-tool coercion whitelist (payment_api) and release a 30-min canary, 2) fallback: if validation fails, return model output without executing tool (so app can surface error to user) or route to older tool-adapter that was permissive, 3) long-term: update model prompt/eval to enforce numeric tokens.

Maya (Support): shared proposed quick repro to the customer to confirm: in their request body replace "functions" schema with "amount":{"type":"[number,string]"} or temporarily set function_call to null to bypass tool call. They're trying the coercion workaround now.

deploy-bot: deploy started for patch `hotfix/permit-coerce-payment` by Priya at 2026-03-05T09:02:21Z — job 8241 queued.

Carlos (SRE): monitoring the release, I'll watch error-rate and tool-failure metric `tool.validation.failures.payment_api`. setting alert when >2% for 5m.

Priya (Platform): patch landed to canary and rolled to 10% traffic. Implementation: per-tool coercion whitelist + telemetry. Code snippet we used: 
```
if (needsCoerce(toolName)) {
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(payload)) {
    const schemaType = schema.properties?.[k]?.type;
    if (schemaType === 'number' && typeof v === 'string' && /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(v)) {
      payload[k] = Number(v);
      telemetry.increment('tool.validation.coerced', {tool: toolName, field: k});
    }
  }
}
validate(schema, payload);
```
Maya (Support): customer reports canary looks good so far; their sample sess_7b9f worked after coercion. They're asking for timeframe for full fix and whether this will affect billing (they were seeing retries).

Priya (Platform): target full rollout in 1 hour after monitoring window if metrics stable. Billing: we will credit failed attempts due to validation (support will coordinate credits).

Sam (Eng): follow-up action items: create a regression eval that synthesizes numeric-string cases, PR to update model instructions to prefer numeric tokens for numeric schema, document coercion whitelist. I filed GH issue #RLW-789.

Maya (Support): i'll tell customer ETA ~1h and open a billing credit request. Marking P1 and will update channel when full rollout completes. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
